narrative.details:
adventurer, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: I appreciate the lookin' out, champion. That marshal's just a worrywart.Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
